instruments.does_not_establish: that anything is in contact, or that the drawn mesh follows the bone
instruments.establishes: where a bone is in the final pose

instruments.does_not_establish: that the target is reachable, correct, or a physical support
instruments.establishes: how far a limb ended from the point a solver asked for

instruments.does_not_establish: that the pose reaches it, or that the rig enforces the limit
instruments.establishes: whether a point lies within the limb's length from its root (a display convention, 97% of the arm)

instruments.does_not_establish: that the body is physically supported or touching anything
instruments.establishes: that the animation system CLAIMS a contact (owner, weight, plan)
instruments.reason: nothing of this kind occurred in the recording, or the instrument was off

instruments.does_not_establish: that the drawn mesh intersects it: armor can be thicker or thinner than the capsule
instruments.establishes: overlap of approximate limb volumes (capsules from bone lengths and measured radii) with a shape
instruments.reason: available in the Workbench (Diagnostics tab) but not recorded per frame

instruments.does_not_establish: a full intersection: a thin crossing between two vertices can be missed, and a vertex on a bar's axis reads the bar's whole radius
instruments.establishes: how many sampled vertices of the drawn skinned mesh lie inside a shape
instruments.reason: nothing of this kind occurred in the recording, or the instrument was off

instruments.establishes: triangle against shape intersection of the drawn mesh
instruments.reason: ADDA has no instrument for this

instruments.does_not_establish: anything about the drawn mesh unless the shapes are the mesh
instruments.reason: ADDA has no instrument for this

limitations: Every pose value is read inside skeleton_updated (the final pose) and is one row per rendered frame; the last update of a frame wins.
A finding is an observation of recorded numbers. Hypotheses are unconfirmed; the cause is unknown unless a finding says it was measured.
Thresholds decide what is reported (20 mm hand, 30 mm foot, 15 mm slide, 97% of the arm, snap = speed over 4x the neighbours plus 1 m/s); the values are always in the finding.
Snap and frame-count metrics depend on the frame rate; lengths depend on the body size. Compare reports with ReportCompare, which says when a comparison is not valid.
Vertex overlap counts sampled skinned vertices only; full mesh intersection and physical collision are not measured.
A support claim is the animation system's claim, not physical support.

summary.headline: 7 findings: 5 high, 2 medium, 0 low. These are measurements; the causes are unknown unless a finding says otherwise.
